params.name: include_deleted
params.description: When set to `true`, includes soft-deleted wallets in the response. When `false` or omitted, only non-deleted wallets are returned.

params.name: supported_assets
params.description: Comma-separated list of asset codes or IDs to filter wallets by supported assets (max 20).

items.docs: Fetches the list of available wallet providers to populate the dropdown box in the New Disbursement flow. The organization should coordinate with the wallet provider before selecting a particular wallet provider for a disbursement. By default, soft-deleted wallets are excluded from the response. Use the `include_deleted` parameter to include them.
Creates a new wallet provider that can be used for disbursements. The wallet must be configured with supported assets and proper authentication domains.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the wallet to update

items.docs: This endpoint is used to enable or disable a wallet provider. Note: the organization should coordinate with the wallet provider before selecting a particular wallet provider for a disbursement.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the wallet to delete
